answer_1.quote: we describe an automated method for training LLMs to generate UI code from textual descriptions.

answer_2.quote: We used a combination of automated metrics and human preferences to evaluate UI code.

answer_3.quote: The CLIP score filter uses a vision-language model to assign a numerical score to each input/output pair that measures how well the generated UI matches the input description.

answer_4.quote: We ran a small-scale preference-based evaluation with six human raters, who were part of the research team.
